# High Desert Development

> General contractor in California City, California. Underground utilities, custom homes,
> ADUs, commercial construction, concrete, wood framing, septic and sewer, remodeling and
> backyard sports courts. Building in the High Desert since 1999.

## Business facts
- Name: High Desert Development
- Owner: Jerry Heller
- Founded: 1999
- California Contractors State License Board licence: 771814
- Licensed, bonded and insured
- Phone: 760-382-2658
- Email: highdesertdevelopment@yahoo.com
- Based in: California City, California 93505
- Service area: Kern County, Los Angeles County and Inyo County, California
- Cities served: California City, Palmdale, Lancaster, Mojave, Rosamond, Tehachapi,
  Quartz Hill, Littlerock, Pearblossom, Sun Village, Lake Los Angeles, Acton, Agua Dulce,
  Leona Valley, North Edwards, Antelope Valley
- Construction financing is available on custom homes, ADUs and larger projects
- 10% discount for veterans
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7am to 5pm Pacific

## Services
- Underground utilities: wet and dry utilities, sewer and septic systems, deep wells,
  trenching, C-900 pipe, hydrants, land clearing, site preparation and grading
- New residential construction and custom homes
- Custom ADUs and pool houses
- Commercial construction and build-outs
- Concrete: foundations, slabs, driveways, stamping and colouring, walkways, patios, block walls
- Wood framing, residential and commercial
- Remodeling: kitchens, bathrooms, room additions, fireplaces
- Sports courts: pickleball, tennis and basketball, indoor or outdoor
- Water truck for dust control

## Notes
- Several trades are kept in house rather than subcontracted.
- This is a service area business. Work is carried out at the customer's property.
